question: Should routine restart-required `config.patch` and `config.apply` writes in hot mode stop direct-restarting and instead return a restart-required notice?
rationale: Both behaviors are internally consistent, but changing the established control-plane restart behavior affects existing operator integrations and cannot be resolved from correctness tests alone.

options.title: Align RPC With File Hot Mode
options.body: Adopt the PR behavior so routine hot-mode RPC writes require an explicit restart while security-critical writes restart automatically.

options.title: Preserve Direct RPC Restart
options.body: Keep current-main direct restarts for routine hot-mode RPC writes while retaining the file-watcher security carve-out.

recommendation.title: Align RPC With File Hot Mode
recommendation.body: Adopt the PR behavior so routine hot-mode RPC writes require an explicit restart while security-critical writes restart automatically.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the hot-mode reload branch and has the strongest merged-history ownership across gateway reload, secrets, and config-write behavior.
